def analyze(lo,hi,delta=800):
    # build incrementally over full log but only count closing edges in [lo,hi]
    nb=collections.defaultdict(dict)  # node -> neighbor -> list of times

            for w in common:

                if t-m<=delta:
                    res.append((u,v,t,w,t1,t2,t-m))
        nb[u].setdefault(v,[]).append(t)
        nb[v].setdefault(u,[]).append(t)
    return res
